summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Nexa Resources S.A., a foreign private issuer, furnishing its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report covers ESG initiatives and performance data for the period ended December 31, 2025, and was prepared in accordance with IIRC, GRI, SASB, and TCFD frameworks. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. This filing is a standard periodic disclosure without any deal terms or corporate action.
